en-US.title: iTrackHabit - Habit Tracker
en-US.subtitle: Build Better Routines
en-US.description:
Build better routines, one day at a time. iTrackHabit is a calm, beautiful habit tracker that works entirely on your device — no account, no sign-up, no waiting on a server.

🌟 KEY FEATURES:

✓ No Account Needed - Open the app and start tracking. There is nothing to sign up for.
✓ Fully Offline - Everything lives on your device, so it works in airplane mode and never waits on a connection.
✓ Smart Progress Tracking - Visual progress rings and streak counters keep you motivated
✓ Flexible Habit Goals - Set daily, weekly, or custom frequency targets
✓ Habit Templates - Start from a prepared habit, or build your own from scratch
✓ Achievement Badges - Unlock rewards as you hit milestones and maintain streaks
✓ Insights - Charts and patterns drawn from your own records, calculated on your device
✓ Local Reminders - Gentle nudges at the times you choose
✓ Export & Backup - Take your data out as a JSON or CSV file whenever you want

🎯 PERFECT FOR:
• Building morning routines
• Fitness and health goals
• Learning new skills
• Breaking bad habits
• Productivity improvement
• Personal development

🔒 GENUINELY PRIVATE:
Your habits never leave your device. There is no account, no server, no advertising, and no analytics or tracking of any kind — we could not see your data even if we wanted to. Your data leaves only when you export it yourself.

💪 START TODAY:
Whether you want to drink more water, exercise daily, read regularly, or build any positive habit, iTrackHabit gives you the tools to stay with it.

Free, with every feature unlocked. No subscriptions, no in-app purchases.
